function.name: finance_fetchGDP
function.description: Fetch the GDP of the given country in the given year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

country.description: The name of the country to get the GDP of.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time statistics for the Gini coefficient.  
The most recent publicly available figures come from the U.S. Census Bureau’s “Income Inequality” tables:

| Year | Gini coefficient (U.S.) |
|------|--------------------------|
| 2021 | **0.485** |

This is the latest estimate released by the Census Bureau (published in early 2023). Earlier estimates were 0.421 in 2018 (World Bank) and 0.394 in 2019 (OECD), but those are older than the 2021 figure above. If you need the absolute latest number beyond 2021, you would need to consult the most recent Census release or other up‑to‑date databases.
